title: In the Moment
paragraphs: These two pieces depict different types of memory. The left combines elements from my home and friends' homes into a composite room, where each corner holds a timeless interaction. The vibrant colors detach the viewer from my specific memories, inviting them to reflect on their own. The right portrays an imagined memory of a prom I never attended, rendered in vibrant pinks and deep purples. Faceless figures in elegant attire convey the surreal quality of an experience I could only dream of, while a single black-and-white figure with a blank cutout represents me: a shadow observing from afar, absent from the tangible reality of the scene.
